question: Can the 1592-1594 wartime loss/recovery record and the surviving Ryu calendar series define whether the 1580 and 1604 Inryeokja controls may be assumed to use one continuous physical type stock?

event_sequence.event: capital fell during Imjin invasion; calendar instruments/equipment were dispersed/lost
event_sequence.text_marker: 曆器等物 蕩失無餘

event_sequence.event: officials accompanying the court obtained calendrical books and produced the Gyeyu calendar by carved blocks
event_sequence.text_marker: 造癸巳曆 以刻板印出

event_sequence.event: after the court returned, someone recovered calendar casting types and presented them
calendar printing was resumed according to former practice

corroborated_points: Inryeokja was already used before the Imjin War.
The wartime loss/dispersal and later recovery account is repeated in institutional specialist references.
The exact beginning/casting date remains unknown.

catalog_tension.generic_claim: Daetong calendars 1594-1598 grouped under iron Inryeokja

continuity_adjudication.interpretation: The wartime evidence forces a two-sided firewall. Some prewar calendar types were recovered, so total discontinuity is not proven; the stock had been dispersed and only a recovered subset is attested, so complete stock continuity is not proven either.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1580 Gyeongjin Inryeokja -> 1604 Ryu Gabjin exact physical-sort continuity
1592 wartime loss -> complete destruction of all calendar sorts
postwar recovery -> same complete prewar stock
visual nearest-neighbor across the wartime boundary -> GK02538 casting generation/date
unresolved_lineage_questions: Which specific prewar sorts were recovered after the Imjin loss and which were replaced or supplemented?
Can 1604 object-specific type-body measurements or chained-sort diagnostics be recovered?
Can Kim Sang-Ho 1987 full text provide object-level criteria for prewar/postwar Inryeokja subtypes?
transmission_impact.interpretation: 12EP converts the Imjin-war production history into an explicit physical-sort continuity firewall without forcing either total continuity or total discontinuity.

next_gate: Recover Kim Sang-Ho 1987 full text or another object-level typographic study that distinguishes recovered, recast and supplemented postwar Inryeokja stock.
Continue the independent pre-1578 exact Sanming/Yueling Rainwater+Dahan fingerprint and threshold-operator search.
